subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Hi Sarah —

Great to speak just now. Quick recap from our discovery and a couple of follow-ups so we can size pricing/next steps: 

Summary of use case:
- Primary: customer support summarization + agent assist (multi-turn chat).
- Secondary: automated outgoing notifications + personalized content generation.
- Typical prompt sizes: ~400–800 tokens input, ~150–350 tokens response (varies by flow).

Open items we talked about I wanted to confirm:
1) Expected monthly token volume (input+output combined). Any ballpark range helps (e.g., 10M / 50M / 100M tokens).
2) Peak TPS requirement (we saw you mentioned higher traffic during weekday mornings). Is peak measured as sustained 1–5 min windows or instantaneous bursts?
3) Target budget or unit economics you’re aiming for (e.g., target $/1M tokens or $/month).

Attachments: I’m attaching a draft SOW and a simple pricing model we typically use to map tokens -> estimated monthly spend.

Next steps: if you can share the two numbers above (monthly tokens + peak TPS) I’ll run a tailored pricing estimate and propose a short pilot (2–4 weeks) with trial credits so you can validate latency and unit cost.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (1 page, draft)
Attachment: pricing_model.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 17:03:24 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Thanks Ben — good call. A few clarifications / numbers from our side: 

- Monthly tokens (estimate, input+output): ~75,000,000 tokens/month. This is based on projected 150k conversations/month with average combined token usage ~500 tokens/conversation.
- Traffic profile: baseline ~0.6–1.5 TPS, predictable spikes during 9–11am PST weekdays up to ~12 TPS for ~15–30 minute windows. Spikes are short but frequent.
- Budget target: we’re trying to land total infra + API spend around $1,200–$1,800/month initially; roughly aiming for a target unit cost of $15–$20 per 1M tokens (we know that sounds aggressive but that’s the target from finance).

We do have SOC 2 and a few security requirements — happy to share the questionnaire separately. Also looping Alex (cc) who owns procurement; he may push on contract duration.

If you can send a pricing estimate based on 75M tokens + the peak TPS profile and any options for burst protection / autoscaling, that’d be great. Also curious about any commitment tiers we should consider to lower unit cost.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Product
FinTechCo

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintechco.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:20:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Thanks for the details — super helpful. A few quick clarifying Qs so the estimate is accurate: 

- Token accounting: we bill on input+output tokens, so your 75M estimate looks like it maps 1:1 to our billing units. If some flows are longer, that will push the total up.
- Peak TPS: when you say ~12 TPS for 15–30 minute windows, is that per region (US-West) or global? Also, do you need <200ms p50 latency or is p95 SLA okay to be higher?

Preliminary unit economics (very rough):
- At 75M tokens/month, target $15–$20/1M would imply monthly API spend of $1,125–$1,500 (aligned with finance target).
- We can offer a commitment tier (6–12 months) to hit lower band pricing; without commitment the standard hosted tier is modestly higher.

I attached an updated pricing_model.xlsx with three scenarios: No commitment, 6-month commit, and 12-month commit. It also shows estimated peak capacity needs (we size for sustained peak windows and short burst capacity).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll run a concrete quote (numbers + sizing) after you confirm whether peak is per-region (answering that will determine whether we need multi-region routing).
2) If numbers look good, we can spin up a 2–4 week pilot with trial credits and a tailored rate card for the pilot.
3) Marissa (cc) will be your main contact for contracting and the SOW.

I’m free for a 20-min follow-up tomorrow if you’d like to walk the numbers together.

Cheers,
Ben

Attachment: pricing_model.xlsx (updated with commit scenarios)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly tokens & peak TPS

Ben — thanks, that breakdown is exactly what we needed. Quick answers: 
- Peak TPS is per-region (US-West only for now).
- Latency: p95 <= 500ms is acceptable for most agent-assist flows; a handful of high-priority flows need p95 <= 300ms.

We’re comfortable starting with a 2–4 week pilot. Preferred start date: next Monday (2026-03-09) so we can validate with a small traffic subset before ramping. Alex will coordinate contract/PO timing but we don’t expect long delays.

Please go ahead and send the pilot rate card and SOW; Alex, loop me if you need a PO or formal procurement info.

Appreciate it — excited to test this.

—Sarah
